report.summary: The fresh-boot path is clean (display fixed once and for all, console reachable), but the previous critical is NOT fixed: a boot with stored Wi-Fi credentials still aborts with "A stack overflow in task sys_evt has been detected" right after MQTT initialized, so a commissioned panel is dead after every power cycle.

deviceInfo.appVersion: zerocode_ai_firmware 1.0.0, ESP-IDF e9da155a, ELF SHA256 abfbdf613
deviceInfo.bootTime: fresh boot reaches the console ~2.1 s after reset; configured boot aborts ~1.7 s after reset
deviceInfo.chip: ESP32-S31 rev v0.0, 2 cores, 16 MB flash, 16 MB PSRAM
deviceInfo.connectivity: no broker peer on the emulator; onboarding SoftAP up when unconfigured; with stored Wi-Fi the panel crashes right after MQTT init
deviceInfo.crash: stack overflow in task sys_evt (vApplicationStackOverflowHook, FreeRTOS port.c:730) at I (1664); emulator exit code 1
deviceInfo.freeHeap: not re-read on the crashed boot; ~12.5 MB free overall / ~65 KB internal DRAM on the fresh boot

notes: This is the same signature as the previous round's critical, at the same timestamp in the boot (I (1664) app_mqtt: MQTT initialized then the overflow), so the reported fix did not take effect on the emulated image.

Two candidate reasons the fix does not act, both visible in the tree: (a) sdkconfig.defaults does not carry CONFIG_ESP_SYSTEM_EVENT_TASK_STACK_SIZE=4096 — the file ends at the DVP/esp-dsp comments and the overflowed task is precisely sys_evt, so the 4096 value is not in this build; (b) sys_evt still does real work — app_mqtt.cpp:244-252 keeps esp_wifi_connect() (STA_START) on the event task, and the product's own app_webui/mdns/httpd and the heating_mqtt data handler are all notified from it, so anything of theirs that runs in-line still lands on the 2.3 KB default.
Independently of the cause, a configured panel cannot boot: this is the scenario the spec describes for a power blink ('comes back on the last saved targets'), and it does not hold.

The earlier display boot-loop IS fixed and stays fixed: one setup pass, the second init refused with a warning, panel + touch registered, no LVGL teardown, no assert — on both the fresh and the configured boot up to the crash point.

Fresh-boot and console behaviour is unchanged from the passing run: 17 of 17 phrases, dashboard up (4 rooms), settings page + web UI, onboarding SoftAP, SNTP, panel logic, console. 'heating' still lists the four spec rooms with their exact TRV topics and reports 'panel is offline (nothing is published)'.
artifacts/device.log holds this session: fresh boot, the Wi-Fi/broker setup, and the configured reboot that crashed.
report.suggestedFix: Make the fix actually present in the build and remove the remaining work from the event task: (1) add CONFIG_ESP_SYSTEM_EVENT_TASK_STACK_SIZE=4096 to sdkconfig.defaults (it is absent today, and sys_evt is the task that overflows) and confirm the built image's .config/sdkconfig.h actually defines it at 4096; (2) move the STA_START esp_wifi_connect() call off the event task too (notify the mqtt_net task like the disconnect/GOT_IP paths already do), so no product handler runs in-line on sys_evt. Then verify by booting with stored Wi-Fi credentials twice in a row: both boots must reach 'Console ready' and 'ZeroCode AI firmware started' with no stack-overflow hook.

tests.details: One display_setup pass on both boots, the second init refused with a warning, RGB panel and GT1151 touch registered, no 'Stopped LVGL task', no assert, no reboot loop.

tests.name: Room table, setpoint surface and offline refusal (f8, f4, f16, f12)

tests.details: Setting 'mqtt-wifi' and 'mqtt-broker' then rebooting gives a boot that aborts with a stack overflow in the FreeRTOS system event task ('sys_evt') at the first Wi-Fi event after 'MQTT initialized'; the emulator exits (code 1) before app_logic/app_console, so a configured panel never comes back from a power cycle. Same signature as last round, unchanged at I (1664). The claimed counter-measures are not in the path: sdkconfig.defaults has no CONFIG_ESP_SYSTEM_EVENT_TASK_STACK_SIZE line, and STA_START still calls esp_wifi_connect() in-line on sys_evt (app_mqtt.cpp:244-252).
tests.evidence: I (1664) wifi:Password length matches WPA2 standards, authmode threshold changes from OPEN to WPA2 / I (1664) app_mqtt: MQTT initialized (node 240ac4000001) / [WARN machine] Firmware abort on hart0: '***ERROR*** A stack overflow in task sys_evt has been detected.' / #1 vApplicationStackOverflowHook () at components/freertos/FreeRTOS-Kernel/portable/riscv/port.c:730 / [host] emulator stopped: esp-emu exited on its own (exit code 1)
tests.name: Boot with stored Wi-Fi credentials — no stack overflow / reset (previously failing)

tests.details: mqtt-wifi / mqtt-broker save their values ('wifi config saved', 'broker config saved') and the following boot does read them (station mode, right password event), but that boot is the one that crashes. So nothing stored by commissioning survives a restart in a usable way.
tests.evidence: wifi config saved — connecting / broker config saved / then the sys_evt overflow on the next boot
tests.name: Commissioned settings usable after reboot
